items.headline: Roblox Reality brings greater realism to Roblox graphics
items.excerpt: At RDC 2026 Roblox exec Anupam Singh demoed Roblox Reality, a video world model that layers photoreal lighting and detail on top of blocky Roblox geometry at runtime. It reframes the art pipeline: creators keep building simple shapes while a generative render pass supplies the finish.

items.headline: Roblox shows off Playtest Agent for Roblox devs to test games
items.excerpt: Roblox announced Playtest Agent with multiplayer support, an AI agent that drives keyboard and mouse input, reads logs, captures screenshots and reports design and gameplay bugs back to Assistant for automatic fixes. QA and design iteration move from manual passes to agent loops.

items.headline: Roblox dives into the details on its RDC: engine updates, Roblox Wallet, and offline play
items.excerpt: A full press-briefing rundown of Roblox's RDC 2026 technology stack: engine updates, generative creation flows, NPC capability expansion, browser and offline play, and creator monetization. The clearest single map of where Roblox wants creator workflows to sit next year.

items.headline: Roblox is making it easier to build games with AI — and play them outside Roblox
items.excerpt: Roblox is widening its prompt-to-game 'Build' feature to desktop with a new asset library and iterative control, and expanding NPC capabilities including NPCs that can playtest a game. Games built this way will also run in the browser outside Roblox.

items.headline: How EchoForge Uses Spatial Sound to Build 3D Worlds in Unity
items.excerpt: Researchers Anamaria Buliga and Kamil Tebani explain how EchoForge combines spatial audio analysis, scene graphs and procedural generation to turn sound recordings into explorable Unity environments. A rare look at non-visual input driving level generation.

items.headline: Official Unity Plugin for Claude Code
items.excerpt: Unity shipped an official Claude Code plugin that installs Unity-authored skills, the Unity CLI and live Editor control via Unity's MCP server in a single command. Agentic coding now has a sanctioned path into the Unity Editor itself.

items.headline: Report: EA is using genAI for commentator voiceover in NHL 27
items.excerpt: A sports commentator says EA used generative AI to produce voiceover lines in NHL 27, and EA confirmed the practice. Synthetic voice moves from experiment to shipped audio content in a AAA annual franchise.

items.headline: Electronic Arts admits to using AI voices in NHL 27: 'This process allows us to bring more variety to the game'
items.excerpt: EA says the AI commentary voices in NHL 27 were developed with the talent involved and let the team deliver far more line variety than a studio session could. The justification is a template other live-service audio teams will reuse.

items.headline: "What in the vibe-coded s*** is this" - RuneScape players revolt as gen-AI copycat game appears and eventually attracts the eye of Jagex
items.excerpt: Elderwood, a generative-AI-built website its creator called an Old School RuneScape clone, was pulled after Jagex took notice. A live case study in what vibe-coded game production actually produces — and how fast players and IP owners react.

items.headline: Saber Interactive's Tim Willits on generative AI, moving development out of North America, and embracing recognisable IP
items.excerpt: Saber's chief creative officer lays out where the studio does and does not let generative AI into production after its CEO's comments caused a backlash. A concrete read on how a mid-size publisher is drawing craft boundaries.

items.headline: European game developers are more concerned that AI will pressure them to work faster rather than take their job
items.excerpt: A new employment survey finds 61% of European devs fear AI means pressure to ship faster, half worry it lowers quality, and 46% say it makes real skill harder to assess. The AI anxiety has shifted from replacement to intensification.

items.headline: Arm explains its mobile-first AI-reconstruction technology, which takes a different tack from the "black box" approach of DLSS 5
items.excerpt: Arm details a mobile-first neural upscaling approach and argues it is deliberately not generative: "Our networks are not generative, so they're not from the same nature as the latest DLSS model." A direct fight over how much AI should be allowed to invent pixels.

items.headline: NBA 2K27 gives DLSS 5 a more faithful-looking game debut than feared, provided it's running on the LeBron of GPUs
items.excerpt: DLSS 5's generative neural rendering makes its first shipped appearance in NBA 2K27, and it is subtler than the demos suggested — but brutally expensive. The first real data point on what AI rendering does to an artist's intended look.

items.headline: "This is super, super heavy" - Experts test Nvidia's divisive graphics-altering DLSS 5 tech and find it really does tank your game's frame-rate
items.excerpt: Independent testing confirms Nvidia's gen-AI-powered DLSS 5 imposes a heavy frame-rate cost, raising the question of whether AI-altered visuals are worth the performance trade for developers targeting it.

items.headline: It's still very much possible to make good Skyrim mods "without any use of AI" in 2026, declares the maker of a new DLC-sized Black Marsh expansion
items.excerpt: King of the Murkmire, a DLC-sized Skyrim expansion mod, ships with an explicit no-AI credit as its maker pushes back on the assumption that hobby-scale content now requires generative tooling.

items.headline: I'm not saying Fallout 4 modding drama gets to people, but here's Breaking Benjamin's singer begging concertgoers to try his AI-assisted first person mod
items.excerpt: Breaking Benjamin's Benjamin Burnley is pleading with fans to try the AI-assisted Fallout 4 first-person mod he built, after the modding community pushed back. AI-assisted UGC is now colliding with community norms about authorship.

items.headline: 'You Were a Beautiful Studio' — Level-5 Dev Calls AI Backlash a 'Learning Opportunity' as Fans Worry for Professor Layton's Future
items.excerpt: Level-5 has apologised for and explained its generative AI use after fans spotted AI artefacts in footage of Professor Layton and the Curious Village, DecaPolice and other reveals. A studio with a signature hand-drawn look getting caught mid-pipeline shift.

items.headline: Twitch Plans To Shove More AI Down Creators' Throats With Stream Coach Tool
items.excerpt: Twitch is testing an AI-powered stream coach that analyses a channel and suggests improvements, alongside questions about content training and opt-outs. Creative direction for game creators, delivered as an algorithmic recommendation.

items.headline: 'Gen-AI Controversy Aside' Is A Wild Thing To Write In A Video Game Preview
items.excerpt: A pointed critique of previews that bracket off a game's generative AI use as a footnote, using Crazy Taxi: World Tour as the example. Argues AI in the asset pipeline is a craft fact, not an aside.

items.headline: After being accused of AI use, Humankind 2 studio proves its new trailer was made by real humans, old fashioned CGI, and at least five chickens
items.excerpt: Amplitude Studios published production evidence — CG artists, a human crew and live chickens — after the internet called Humankind 2's trailer AI slop. Proving human authorship is now itself a deliverable in game marketing.
